The '''Tredway family''' was a family that lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and through the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. [[Axton Tredway]], a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], broke the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] when he fell in love with his [[Tredway|future wife]] and sired two children, [[Erling Tredway|Erling]] and [[Dena Tredway|Dena]].

Before the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Axton Tredway confided in his friend, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and showed him his family and his home on [[24 Tredway]]. When [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] overthrew the Republic and [[Order 66/Legends|destroyed]] the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Tredway fled back to his family's home amidst the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]]. Using the knowledge which Tredway had shared with Skywalker&mdash;now the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader&mdash;attacked 24 Tredway. Axton fled, hoping to draw away the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]'s ire, however, it continued to harass the family, and Tredway returned. He fought off the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], defeating them, but Vader himself soon arrived. The two former friends [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]], and Tredway was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Vader.
